title: Prompt lookup on v0.15.1: 32K timing qualification and 262K vision deployment compatibility

final_candidate.contents: upstream v0.15.1 f7116129 + resolve.py port, spacing test, page-by-page backing commit, --prepare-structured-output, --cache-ram-commit eager (baseline); + the four prompt-lookup files (candidate); + opt-in --prepare-vision (both lines, patch-id 1c1a86d8)
final_candidate.checks: formatting and hosted PR suite (format, dependencies, docs, CPU contract suite incl. serve_cli_test, CLI strings) pass on both; gpu-test qwen_vision_prepare_test passes; no diagnostic strings

timing_qualification.why_applicable_to_final: the final candidate adds only --prepare-vision, whose code runs only when the flag is passed; the timed configuration does not pass it; the newer binaries were not re-timed
timing_qualification.policy: tests/functional/resolve.py screen-resolution-v2 (sha256 ee30e19c...), 5% / 3 ms per request and phase, unchanged
timing_qualification.design: 35 alternating matched pairs (sp71 q1-q8 + sp72 q9-q35, fixed count of 27 additional pairs chosen before data), control q1-A + vA1
timing_qualification.configuration: 1 host (Strix Halo gfx1151), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-Q4_K_XL + shared Q8_0 MTP, 2 sessions, context 32768, harness disk cache, --cache-ram-bytes 17179869184 --cache-ram-commit eager --prepare-structured-output; suites state-edges, tool-agent, long-context, cache (with restart); harness sha256 ce4f7ede...

formerly_inconclusive_rows.note: slow state (>69.5 ms) in 6/35 A runs and 11/35 B runs (Fisher two-sided p = 0.26); a modest frequency increase is not excluded

timing_qualification.history: sp71 8-pair campaign of the same builds: 910 passed, 3 inconclusive (retained); v0.15.0 claim withdrawn 2026-10-15 (prompt-lookup-v015-correction.json)

deployment_compatibility.scope: final candidate, 1 session, configured context 262144, vision, --cache-ram-bytes 17179869184 --cache-ram-commit eager --prepare-structured-output --prepare-vision; compatibility evidence, not timing qualification

sp73_harness_runs.runs: v1 (sidecar page cache dropped first) and v2
sp73_harness_runs.sequence: discovery, state-edges, tool-agent, image-inputs, cache with restart; 128x128 image fixtures; harness disk cache
sp73_harness_runs.results: all 117 requests identical to the pre-fix run (hashes, outputs, token and cache counts, 10 disk restores); preparation before readiness; first image request queue 6.7-6.9 ms (pre-fix 371-490 ms), TTFT 640-642 ms (pre-fix 1,042-1,056 ms); about 25 fresh image encodes per process without persistent growth; minimum host available 10,728 MiB, GTT free 34,775 MiB

sp74_representative_image.image: 1920x1080 screenshot-style PNG (fictional app, sha256 1a573da1...), resized by the encoder to 1920x1088 = 8,160 patches = 2,040 image tokens
sp74_representative_image.requests: fresh image request, identical repeat, strict tool request, model listing
sp74_representative_image.results: correct description (application, window title, button); repeat fully reused (2,077 cached tokens); correct get_weather(Paris, celsius); server GTT +438 MiB at the first request (text-path first-request buffers + 19.9 MiB embedding), +1.7 MiB on repeat, +105 MiB on the tool request; zero direct reclaim, compaction and container memory pressure; host available >= 15,184 MiB, GTT free >= 34,804 MiB; encoder transient peak for this grid 430.6 MiB (from its allocations); ready in 36.0 s

preparation_costs.device_memory_at_readiness: +1,004 MiB (903,984,064 B weights + 141.9 MiB one-time GPU runtime state)
preparation_costs.process_rss: includes about 866 MiB of clean, mapped sidecar pages
preparation_costs.startup_s: 35.8 to load_completed without disk cache; 82.9-83.3 with the harness disk cache (artifact fingerprinting)

accepted_specification_errors.original: FAIL in v1 and v2, both processes: 91,611.4 MiB vs expected 91,469.5 +/- 64 MiB
accepted_specification_errors.disposition: the criterion expected only the weights; preparation also performs a one-time process-wide GPU runtime/library allocation (141.9 MiB) that the unchanged build made lazily at an early text request: that +145/151 MiB serving step disappears, the initial process ends serving with identical device memory (92,167.5 MiB), repeated requests do not accumulate it, and admission's free-memory figure is 1,873 MiB lower; a process that never encodes an image holds +1,004 MiB from readiness; the owning allocation was not identified at code level

accepted_specification_errors.original: FAIL: system PSI memory some +17.3 ms while serving
accepted_specification_errors.disposition: system PSI also counts kswapd; the server container's memory PSI was 0 and there was no direct reclaim or compaction; headroom held. Request-level effect recorded, not dismissed: r85 and r94 took +201/+186 ms wall and r102 +37 ms TTFT while the server major-faulted (102/100/17) on about 870 MiB of file-backed model data read from the SSD after a cold page cache (sidecar not involved); the same requests in v2 and the pre-fix run had no faults; shared text-path behavior unchanged by the candidate

the threshold was calibrated on 128x128 images to detect the 371-490 ms lazy preparation; every image request decodes, resizes and hashes its pixels before admission (vision::Prepare), about 51-58 ms for 1920x1088; R2 was a full cache hit with no encoding yet queued 58.4 ms, and R1 showed no lazy-preparation signature (RssFile +12 MiB)

not_tested: images larger than 1920x1088 (up to 16.7 MP; per-encode scratch up to about 3.4 GB of device memory, not reserved by admission)
concurrent image requests or multiple sessions with vision
image requests on the default lazy path (without --prepare-vision)
evidence: validation/sp72, sp73 (REPORT, PROGRESS, VERIFY, check outputs), sp74 (CHECK, RELEASE-DECISION, results); untracked evidence in the maintainer workspace
